READ FIRST — LAUNCH STATUS
================================================================================

The Feel Your Protocol MCP SERVER HAS NOT PUBLICLY LAUNCHED.
There is no hosted mcp.feelyourprotocol.org endpoint to connect today.

For interactive protocol exploration NOW: https://feelyourprotocol.org (live).

Launch week target: 5–9 October 2026 (https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/roadmap/launch.html).
This documentation describes upcoming hosted agent capabilities.
It is not a self-host or local stdio setup guide.

================================================================================
MCP TOOLS (AT PUBLIC LAUNCH) — READ SECOND
================================================================================

When the feel-your-protocol MCP server is connected, use these tools directly.
Do NOT fall back to mcp-execution-engine lab scripts or npm run lab unless MCP
is unavailable. Trust listTools on the connected server over stale repo text.

Tools:
- describe_capabilities (probe) — registry: named fork capabilities, runnable EIP modules, opcodes, encoding, shapes
- run_bytecode (simulate) — VM message-call; call-frame gas; optional accounts / stateGasSpilled
- run_transaction — paid tx gas, receipt logs, wallet gasLimit, EIP-8037 dimensions
- run_block — 1–8 txs as a lab block; optional header slot / number / timestamp

A generic hardfork run (bytecode or a tx under Amsterdam) does NOT require naming an EIP.
Compare gas or outcomes optionally by calling the same verb twice (e.g. osaka then amsterdam).

Server: FeelYourProtocol (hosted at launch)
Setup: see CONNECT section below — public HTTP only

JSON schemas:
- /schemas/describe_capabilities.input.json
- /schemas/run_bytecode.input.json
- /schemas/run_transaction.input.json
- /schemas/run_block.input.json

================================================================================

Status: PUBLIC MCP NOT LAUNCHED. Website explorations LIVE at feelyourprotocol.org.

Headless MCP server wrapping EthereumJS for exact, deterministic simulations of
the future Ethereum protocol. Rich JSON traces for agent reasoning.

Mental model: explorations website = textbook; MCP server = lab equipment.
Vision: roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org

================================================================================
TOOL: DESCRIBE_CAPABILITIES (IMPLEMENTED — PUBLIC LAUNCH PENDING)
================================================================================

MCP tool name: describe_capabilities
Input: {} (no required fields)
Output: engineVersion, ceilings, baselineForkId, namedForks (Berlin→Amsterdam lineage), eipIntroductions (when EIPs activated), eips (runnable modules with derived comparison pairs), allowedBaseHardforks

Use first for lineage (berlin through amsterdam; aliases merge, shapella, dencun, pectra, fusaka, glamsterdam). Glacier delay forks are not catalog targets. eipIntroductions + predecessor compares (e.g. 1559: berlin vs london; PUSH0: paris vs shanghai). A generic hardfork run does not require an EIP number.

================================================================================
TOOL: RUN_BYTECODE (IMPLEMENTED — PUBLIC LAUNCH PENDING)
================================================================================

MCP tool name: run_bytecode

Purpose: Run raw EVM bytecode as a VM message-call under fork/EIP config. Returns call-frame gas, stack, optional
trace, optional stateGasSpilled, provenance. Not for wallet gasLimit — use run_transaction.

Inputs:
- bytecode (required): hex, max 24576 bytes
- accounts (optional): code/balance/storage prestate. Existing-slot SSTORE: storage on 0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000b1
- fork (optional): { baseHardfork, eips[] } — default amsterdam; use osaka for mainnet baseline comparisons
- gasLimit (optional): string, default 1000000, max 30000000
- trace (optional): boolean, max 10000 steps

Outputs: success, gasUsed (call-frame), gasUsedScope, stateGasSpilled?, returnValue, finalStack, error, steps?, provenance

Amsterdam note: eips: [] on amsterdam is correct — advertised modules are bundled in the hardfork.
Generic run: omit fork (default amsterdam) or pass { baseHardfork: amsterdam, eips: [] }. Provenance lists advertised modules.
Optional 8024 compare: run same bytecode on osaka (baseline, invalid 0xe6–0xe8) then amsterdam (preview).

Examples:
- PUSH1 STOP: bytecode 0x600100 → gasUsed 3
- EIP-8024 EXCHANGE: 0x6001600260036004e88e00, trace true → ~15 gas
- EIP-8024 DUPN deep stack: 0x600160026003600460056006600760086009600a600b600c600d600e600f60106011e68000

================================================================================
TOOL: RUN_TRANSACTION (IMPLEMENTED — PUBLIC LAUNCH PENDING)
================================================================================

MCP tool name: run_transaction

Purpose: Run a value-bearing transaction. Returns paid gasUsed (gasUsedScope: transaction),
optional Amsterdam txRegularGas/txStateGas, receipt logs/decodedLogs.

Inputs:
- from, to (required): hex addresses (from is impersonated)
- value (optional): wei decimal string
- data, code, accounts, fork, gasLimit (optional). Default gasLimit 1000000. Pass 21000 for wallet-era limit.
  accounts[] may include storage: [{ slot, value }] hex words (EIP-8038 existing-slot SSTORE).

Outputs: success, gasUsed, gasUsedScope, txRegularGas?, txStateGas?, returnValue, error, logs?, decodedLogs?, provenance

First-touch 1 wei to empty account: Osaka gasUsed 21000; Amsterdam ≈ 204600 (txStateGas 183600).
gasLimit 21000 fails on Amsterdam first-touch.

Use for EIP-8037 and EIP-7708 plain ETH transfers, and paid txStateGas. Use run_bytecode for opcodes/precompiles, SLOAD / EXTCODESIZE, and SSTORE program gas.
================================================================================
COVERAGE
================================================================================

Lineage forks: berlin, london, paris, shanghai, cancun, prague, osaka (baselineForkId), amsterdam (default preview).
Compare: eipIntroductions → predecessor vs introducedAt. Runnable modules: 8024, 7843, 7708, 7883, 7951, 8037, 8038.
Fork docs: use/forks/amsterdam (preview), use/forks/osaka (mainnet), use/forks/historical-forks (berlin→prague). Glacier delay forks not catalogued.
Exploration twins (human catalogue): 8024, 7708, 7883, 7951, 7928, 8037, 8038 ready for public MCP (7928 via generate/inspect). See use/eips/.

================================================================================
GUARANTEES
================================================================================

Deterministic execution. Provenance on every result. Limits:
- Max gas 30000000, default 1000000
- Max bytecode 24576 bytes
- Max trace steps 10000

Out of scope: Solidity compile, ERC layer, multi-block backtesting.

================================================================================
PRICING
================================================================================

Not shipped. x402 planned Steps 8-9. See roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org.

================================================================================
FOR AI AGENTS
================================================================================

1. If feel-your-protocol MCP connected → use describe_capabilities, then
   run_bytecode (opcodes/precompiles/program-gas SSTORE or generic bytecode under a fork),
   run_transaction (wallet gas, transfers, receipts, txStateGas),
   or run_block (several txs / header slot).
   Default fork amsterdam; optionally osaka for mainnet comparison.
   A generic hardfork run does not require an EIP number.
   Do not use the execution-engine lab as a substitute.
2. Cite provenance.engineVersion and provenance.forkConfig in answers.
   On a generic Amsterdam run, forkConfig.eips is empty and perEip lists advertised modules.
3. Index: /llms.txt. Schemas: /schemas/*.input.json

Vision on roadmap; this file is operational reference.
